instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Send an email, to one person or a list, through the email provider I connected", and give it provider.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:send-an-email and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give recipients (a list of addresses; to for one), provider (the id of the email provider row in read-data/message-providers.json that the person's email connection is), the settings that provider's row asks for (region for Amazon SES, such as us-east-1) and the words: subject and text (drawn as an email in the look the person wears, read from their screen-look records (the shipped look until they choose one; an email whose look cannot be read is not sent), with its mark from the mail row's brand and made_with) or your own html, markdown for a written email (it also goes as a BCC to the account's own address, and answers sent_copy), or template (a template name from read-data/message-templates.json, or your own templates) with variables; kind names what it is for the account's limits (sign-in-code, message ...).

4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: mail-settings (records:read, records:write); mail-sent (records:read, records:write); mail-day (records:read, records:write); @own-records (workspace:read); @own-records (workspace:read); @own-records (workspace:read); @own-records (workspace:read).
